title: Freeze Student V0.1 rich-activity successor architecture
purpose: Define the smallest explicit clean-generation architecture and execution program that can support a 30–45 minute Student V0.1 journey with exposition, active recall, association, ordering, single-label classification, qcm, fill, bounded constructed response and local embedded media without implementing product code in this work package.
invariants: learnit.kit.v2 and contracts/learnit-kit-v2.schema.json retain their existing meaning and bytes.
learnit.kit.v3 and contracts/learnit-kit-v3.schema.json retain their existing meaning and bytes.
learnit.kit.v4 is explicit opt-in; no v2/v3 package is silently reclassified or rewritten.
lesson is non-scored, forbids assessmentRole, and completion is exposure only rather than mastery evidence.
flashcard is reveal-based, non-scored, forbids assessmentRole and is excluded from validation/diagnostic evidence.
qcm and fill preserve existing deterministic behavior.
constructed preserves v3 canonical-text-match-v1 and hidden acceptedResponses.
matching is exact one-to-one with stable item IDs and a hidden complete bijection.
order has stable item IDs and a hidden correctOrder that is an exact permutation.
classify is single-label: every authored item has exactly one hidden correctBucketId resolving to a declared bucket.
Learner-safe ActivityPresentation never exposes correctChoiceId, fill answers, matching matches, correctOrder, correctBucketId or acceptedResponses.
UI owns interaction mechanics only; Learning owns correctness and non-evaluated completion semantics.
Media is package-level embedded/local data referenced by units; no remote URL/source field exists.
SVG admission is fail-closed and reuses proven RC718 safety principles without reusing RC718 identity/storage architecture.
No backend, account, cloud catalog, remote AI scoring, provider runtime, marketplace, event bus or generic evaluator framework is introduced.
Wave 1 workers use one exact post-merge architecture base and pairwise-disjoint write scopes; shared integration files remain JOB 04-owned.
requiredEvidence: Current main is reread before mutation and remains the exact declared baseline.
Issue #380 provides accountable-owner authority to reopen this architecture gate only.
Repository governance and current governor state are reconstructed; governor-state.json remains unchanged.
ARC-WP-024 and v3 establish explicit successor-version precedent and constructed-response secret boundary.
ATLAS-WP-025/current session-UI seam establishes ActivityPresentation -> ActivityResponse -> Learning ownership.
Historical RC718 evidence confirms stable matching/order/flashcard/media capability and fail-closed SVG safety, without serving as migration authority.
The v4 schema passes Draft 2020-12 schema validation and adversarial contract probes.
The exact candidate branch diff contains only the seven declared architecture/program files.
v2 and v3 schema Git blob identities are unchanged on the candidate branch.
adversarialTests: Unknown v4 activity type is rejected.
lesson carrying assessmentRole or any scoring-secret field is rejected.
classify lesign requires one correctBucketId per item and semantic validation of bucket references plus one response assignment per item.
Media asset with src, url or source field is rejected.
Any edit outside the seven allowed paths fails scope.
Any product/app/authoring/workflow/governor-state edit fails this work package.
Any overlap among JOB 01, JOB 02 and JOB 03 writable paths blocks Wave 1.
rollback: Close the DRAFT architecture PR and delete its branch. Main, governor state, product code, authoring code, workflows and frozen v2/v3 contracts remain unchanged.
